plans.idea: Classic skyscraper read: brand at top, a big text column that keeps the headline above its flavour list, then the bottle, then a full-width Build Your Pack button, with the extra bottles and fine print in a small footer.

Product first: a large bottle opens the strip, the copy column follows, the CTA sits right under the copy, and the logo closes the strip as a brand sign-off below a small row of the other two bottles.

Headline-led story: logo and a tall text block take the top half, then the three bottles stack together as one product group (two small ones above the main one, like the original lineup), ending on the CTA at the base.
